recipe.visualDefinition: A monochrome, gritty collage featuring a large central portrait of a man, surrounded by smaller, overlapping photographic elements depicting various scenes and individuals, creating a dense, textured background. The typography is a mix of handwritten script and a sans-serif, positioned over the central figure.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central portrait dominates the composition, acting as a visual anchor.
Smaller, overlapping photographic elements create a dense, collage-like background around the central figure.
Typography is layered over the central figure, integrating with the overall composition.
The monochrome palette unifies disparate photographic elements and enhances the gritty aesthetic.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic color scheme with high contrast.
Central dominant portrait of a man.
Collage of multiple smaller photographic elements forming the background.
Gritty, distressed texture applied across the entire image.
Handwritten script typography for the main title, with a sans-serif subtitle.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject, a man's bust, is centrally positioned and occupies approximately 60-70% of the vertical height and 80% of the horizontal width, making him the dominant element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face and upper torso of the central figure serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the central figure's face, then moves outwards to explore the surrounding collage elements, guided by the overlapping nature and varying scales of the background images. The text acts as a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with imagery, creating a claustrophobic or immersive feel. The central figure's shoulders and chest provide some 'breathing room' for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark grays and blacks provide the dominant tone, establishing a somber and gritty mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright whites and light grays provide high contrast, highlighting details and creating visual separation within the monochrome palette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: No distinct accent color; the monochromatic scheme relies on value and saturation variations.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between dark and light values, with a full range of grays. Saturation is absent due to the monochrome nature.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly black, white, and shades of gray.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title 'SoulFly' uses a script-like base, while 'DELUXE' uses a condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Main title: Script-like, flowing strokes with varying line thickness, mimicking a brush or marker. Letters are connected or nearly connected.
Subtitle: All caps, condensed sans-serif with consistent stroke width.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in 'SoulFly' has an extended, decorative flourish.
The 'F' in 'SoulFly' has a unique, almost calligraphic loop.
The 'y' in 'SoulFly' has a distinctive, elongated descender.

typesetting.case: title case (first letter capitalized, rest lowercase)

composition.position: centered horizontally, slightly below the central figure's chest
composition.overlap: partially overlaps the central figure's torso
composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the foreground, appearing to be part of the figure's clothing or skin

treatment.shadow: subtle dark drop shadow, creating depth

composition.position: centered horizontally, directly below the main title

composition.relationshipToImage: sits on the central figure's torso, below the main title

treatment.shadow: subtle dark drop shadow, creating depth

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting styles: expressive script for the main title paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for the subtitle, creating visual interest and hierarchy.

preserve: Expressive, handwritten feel for the main title.
Condensed, all-caps sans-serif for the subtitle.
White fill with subtle dark shadow for both text elements.
Relative scale and positioning of title and subtitle.
avoid: Geometric or highly structured script fonts for the main title.
Bright colors or gradients for text fill.

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the fluid, handwritten aesthetic of 'SoulFly'.
To match the clean, compact, all-caps style of 'DELUXE'.
To perfectly capture the unique flourishes and connections of the original script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome, gritty photographic collage featuring a central, dominant bust portrait of a man. Surround this figure with numerous smaller, overlapping black and white photographs depicting various scenes, people, and objects, creating a dense, textured background. Ensure a distressed, vintage, or worn filter is applied across the entire image. Leave a clear, but integrated, space on the central figure's chest for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the main title 'SoulFly' as a white, expressive, handwritten script with a subtle dark drop shadow, centered on the central figure's chest. Directly below it, add 'DELUXE' in a smaller, white, condensed all-caps sans-serif font, also with a subtle dark drop shadow. Ensure both text elements appear integrated with the image's texture and depth. Add a standard Parental Advisory label in the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the main title 'SoulFly' rendered in a flowing, handwritten script style?
Is the subtitle 'DELUXE' a condensed, all-caps sans-serif?
Are both text elements white with a subtle dark shadow?
Is the relative scale and positioning of the title and subtitle maintained?
Is the Parental Advisory label present in the bottom center?

adjustableVariables: Specific photographic elements in the background collage (while maintaining density and monochrome aesthetic).
Exact level of grunge/distress applied to the overall image.
Specific script font for 'SoulFly' (as long as it maintains the handwritten, expressive character).
Specific condensed sans-serif font for 'DELUXE' (as long as it maintains the all-caps, clean, compact character).
mustRedesign: Any use of color beyond black, white, and shades of gray.
Replacing the central portrait with a different subject or composition.
Changing the handwritten script style of the main title to a block or serif font.

mustAchieve: A dense, multi-layered collage effect in the background.
Clear visual hierarchy with the central figure and text.
A gritty, authentic, and somewhat raw visual mood.
avoid: Clean, polished, or overly modern aesthetics.
Sparse compositions with large areas of empty space.
Low contrast or muddy gray tones.

postGenerationChecks: Verify that the overall image maintains a strong black and white, high-contrast appearance.
Confirm that the central figure is dominant and surrounded by a dense collage of smaller images.
Check that the main title 'SoulFly' is a white, expressive script with shadow, and 'DELUXE' is a smaller, white, condensed sans-serif with shadow.
Ensure the Parental Advisory label is present and correctly positioned.
Assess if the distressed texture is consistently applied across the entire image.
Confirm that all text elements are legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Generate a monochrome, high-contrast photographic collage with a dominant central portrait. Overlay a large, white, expressive script title with shadow, and a smaller, white, condensed sans-serif subtitle with shadow, both centered on the figure's chest. Add a Parental Advisory label at the bottom center.
